descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S01 Hospital walk through the screens: manual add, duplicate kept, chart opened, encounter completed, task completed and deleted, patient removed — every row lands

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Adding a patient by scan and by manual entry is logged, each add tagged by method (scan vs manual), in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT OAT-06 Test 1; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics)
  • U2 Removing / discharging a patient is logged, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT OAT-06 Test 2; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 Analytics)
  • U3 A duplicate-detection prompt logs that it was shown, and logs whether the physician accepted or rejected it (manual add and scan, both contexts) (UAT OAT-06 Test 3; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 AC 5)
  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day (UAT OAT-06 Test 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 4)
  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately) (UAT OAT-06 Test 7; UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; UAT TC-24; TFA-94514 AC 2)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician (make-session) whose Hospital patient is seeded with status note-ready, a short finished note and two open tasks; run start time T0 recorded so fixture rows are ignored

When Add 'QA Hosp OAT06 Manual' with the add form; add the same name and room again and answer Cancel to the duplicate question; open {hospitalPatient}'s chart on Pre-Round; on Post-Round tap Complete on task 1 and Delete on task 2, then Mark Encounter Complete; …

Then Since T0: patientActivityEvents has patient_added (hospital, addMethod manual) x1, duplicate_prompt_shown + duplicate_prompt_accepted sharing one promptId (addMethod manual), patient_removed (hospital, removalReason manual) x1. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-06 Test 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 and TFA-94514 AC 1/2/4. Post-run backend read (patientActivity:_recentForActor, usage:_recentForActor, usage:_dailyForActor for the physician's local day, filtered on _creationTime >= T0): the exact counts in 'then'; serialised rows mustNotContain both patient names, '4B-61', 'Cellulitis', 'recheck BMP', 'call PT'. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-06/S01

Hospital walk through the screens: manual add, duplicate kept, chart opened, encounter completed, task completed and deleted, patient removed — every row lands

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa); TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Local QA stack only (main e02167f), a brand-new @roundai.test physician per test, synthetic charts deleted after the reads. No model: every ai/* action is refused at the Convex socket and none was sent; tripwire clean for the final run (16:43:28Z mark, 'no model call'). Rows are read with the local admin key (patientActivity / usage / surveys _recentForActor, usage:_dailyForActor) before and after the steps; reading them through Vikram's dashboard on the UAT deployment is S23 / Q12. Seeded one note-ready Hospital chart (finished note, billing code pre-computed) with two open tasks, then on the real screens: Add New Patient 'QA Hosp OAT06 Manual' (70, 4B-61, 'Cellulitis, left leg'); the same patient again -> native confirm 'already on your rounding list - same name and room' answered Cancel; opened the seeded chart on Pre-Round; Post-Round > Tasks: Complete task 1, Delete task 2; Mark Encounter Complete (no pending task, so no question); back on the list removed the added patient (one confirm, OK). Judged 15/15: 4 checkpoints (list after the add; list, not the form, after Cancel; 'Encounter Complete' without the Mark button; list without the removed patient) and 11 row checks since T0: patient_added hospital/manual = 1; duplicate_prompt_shown = 1 + duplicate_prompt_accepted = 1 with the same promptId (hospital, manual), rejected = 0, still one chart with the name; patient_removed hospital/removalReason manual = 1; pre_round_summary_opened = 1, note_marked_complete = 1 (minutesFromPreRoundOpened 0, numeric), task_completed = 1, task_deleted = 1, all with the chart's id and no other usage row; today's hospital pilotDailyRounding preRoundSummariesOpened, notesCompleted, encountersTimed, tasksCompleted, tasksDeleted each +1; no name, room, MRN, diagnosis, task or note text in any row of the account. Record-only: Cancel is logged as 'accepted' (meaning is Q5); the removal asked once (TC-24 / TFA-92579 rule, not this case). The add form was left by URL, not by its header Back button, which submits the form (known B08) and would have added rows.

Evidence: 6 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: permission-add-patient, backend-read-admin. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
